integrity: The triggering source's first-public date and primary MSC were checked on the arXiv record. The source theorem, its definition of Vitali selector, and the DC/BPI/no-selector construction were checked in the full primary text. The Hamel-basis-to-E0-selector implication was checked in the published Larson--Zapletal paper. The conclusion is the direct logical composition of those verified results; no computation is used.
scientific_limitations: This is a relative-consistency separation conditional on Con(ZFC). The proof uses Dependent Choice through the known implication from a Hamel basis to a total E0 selector. It does not assert incompatibility of BPI with Hamel bases, nor settle the exact bare-ZF strength of that implication.
title: BPI with dependent choice need not yield a Hamel basis of the reals
